structure: Part 17, Templates. Read templates.fit.spec.js in full and opened and mined all 12 traces it produced: manage templates (2: the list, and the dashboard 'Use template' button), a saved template (6: view, use, change one section, POST and unknown slug, edit, delete) and create a new template (4: type-name-answers-review-save, no name saved as 'Untitled template', discard while creating, discard outside a template journey). No trace recorded an error. Pages, in journey order: Manage templates (/templates, always, the 'Templates' service-navigation item); create path: /templates/create?new=1 (302) -> What are you importing? (/notification-type, notification type radios, back to /templates) -> Enter template name (/templates/create) -> Origin of the import in template mode -> What are you importing? (commodity) in template mode -> Overview with 'Template tasklist' (/notification-hub, no Documents section) -> Review your template (/review-notification, 'Save template' and 'Delete') -> back to Manage templates with a success banner; /templates/save (GET) saves straight away; /templates/discard is a 'Delete this template?' confirmation only inside a template journey. Saved-template path: view (/templates/<slug>, summary cards per section with Change links to /templates/<slug>/change/<page>), change (302 to the question page with ?from=template-review, 'Save and return' and 'Cancel', then back to the view with an 'updated' banner), use (/templates/<slug>/use, 302 to a new Draft notification's Overview), edit (/templates/<slug>/edit, 302 to the Template tasklist), delete (/templates/<slug>/delete confirmation, then the list with a 'deleted' banner). POST to /templates/<slug> redirects to itself; an unknown slug redirects to /templates. Network: only same-origin prototype page loads and form posts, no data calls. Components: Manage templates is mostly custom app-dr2-dashboard-* classes (template cards as article/dl) around govuk-button, govuk-details, govuk-warning-text, govuk-select; the view page reuses the app-dr2-review-card summary cards; the delete and discard pages and the name page are plain govuk-* (summary list, warning button, button group, input).
